summary: DepEd RPMS-PPST performance evidence matrix mapping the 7 PPST domains, Classroom Observation Tool (COT) ratings, learner outcomes, and critical reflection notes.
rpms_notice: Note for evaluators: RPMS portfolio guidelines, priority indicators, and prescribed means of verification (MOVs) are periodically updated through DepEd Memoranda. All evidence shown below reflects current baseline issuances and is verified annually against the official Results-Based Performance Management System manual.

domains.name: Content Knowledge and Pedagogy
domains.objective: Applied knowledge of content within and across curriculum teaching areas, particularly integrating science concepts with environmental stewardship and mathematics.
domains.movs: Classroom Observation Tool (COT) rating sheet (Rating: 7.0), DLL with interdisciplinary cross-references.
domains.reflection: Integrating stoichiometric calculations with mathematical ratios allowed students to grasp limiting reactants through algebraic expressions rather than abstract memorization.

domains.name: Learning Environment
domains.objective: Established safe and secure learning environments to enhance learning through the consistent implementation of laboratory safety policies and positive discipline.
domains.movs: Signed student laboratory safety agreements, chemical storage inventory sheet, classroom rules poster.
domains.reflection: Introducing clear hazard communication pictograms (GHS) minimized laboratory spills and empowered student lab captains to conduct peer safety checks.

domains.name: Diversity of Learners
domains.objective: Designed, adapted, and implemented teaching strategies that are responsive to learners with diverse cultural, socio-economic, and learning backgrounds.
domains.movs: Differentiated activity rubrics, localized vernacular analogies in introductory science prompts.
domains.reflection: Providing auditory, visual, and tactile lab stations ensured that kinesthetic learners engaged as deeply as visual diagram readers in cellular mitosis demonstrations.

domains.name: Curriculum and Planning
domains.objective: Planned, managed, and implemented developmentally sequenced teaching and learning processes aligned with MATATAG competencies.
domains.movs: Approved Weekly Learning Plan (WLP), Curriculum Unpacking Matrix, DepEd Quality Assured Lesson Exemplar.
domains.reflection: Decongesting the lesson timeline allowed for an entire dedicated day on student hypothesis testing rather than rushing to lecture conclusions.

domains.name: Assessment and Reporting
domains.objective: Designed, selected, organized, and used diagnostic, formative, and summative assessment strategies consistent with curriculum requirements.
domains.movs: Table of Specifications (TOS), item analysis diagnostic chart, digital formative quiz analytics.
domains.reflection: Pre-test item analysis identified misconceptions in electric circuit flows early, allowing targeted remedial mini-lessons before the summative unit test.

domains.name: Community Linkages and Professional Engagement
domains.objective: Maintained learning environments that are responsive to community contexts through partnerships with local government units and parents.
domains.movs: Minutes of PTA meeting on investigatory project field studies, barangay clearance for water sampling activity.
domains.reflection: Engaging community barangay officials for safe river water sampling grounded students' investigatory research directly into urgent local flood and sanitation realities.

domains.name: Personal Growth and Professional Development
domains.objective: Reflected on personal teaching practice and continuously engaged in professional learning to improve practice.
domains.movs: Individual Performance Commitment and Review Form (IPCRF), LAC session documentation, graduate school enrollment.
domains.reflection: Pursuing graduate studies in science education consistently infuses contemporary inquiry research directly into daily classroom pedagogical design.
